product.olivetti-m4-66.summary: The 66 MHz DX2 M4 in the 305 Box chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-66.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. The guide identifies T.1 boards made in Singapore and Scarmagno.
product.olivetti-m4-66.warning: Partial BA2077 emulation using the compatible R2.03 A4BF BIOS.
product.olivetti-m4-66.architecture: The German brochure offered the M4-66 with 4 MB of RAM, 1 MB of video memory and 170/240/540 MB IDE disks. The guide documents T.1 and T.1.5 revisions, including the BA2077 shared with the other Modulo models in this series. OverDrive was an upgrade.
product.olivetti-m4-66.verified: BluMach verified POST, floppy boot, VGA mode 13h and video memory with the stock CPU and 4 MB of RAM. Olivetti Setup saves CMOS and MS-DOS 5.0 boots from IDE with the representative geometries.
product.olivetti-m4-66.limitations: BluMach uses compatible models for the 83C206Q and keyboard controller. Factory disk geometries still need confirmation.
product.olivetti-m4-66.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-66.firmware: The preserved M4-65 R2.03 A4BF BIOS boots this BA2077 configuration. The guide documents 2.06 PDK0 as the last service revision. This model’s factory BIOS remains unconfirmed.
product.olivetti-m4-66.source-brochure: Olivetti GmbH, M4-60/62/64/65/66 Modulo · Drucknummer 12129 · p. 2
product.olivetti-m4-66.creation.note: Place the compatible 128 KiB M4-65 ROM at roms/machines/olivetti_m4_65/R2_03_A4BF.BIN.
product.olivetti-m4-66.source-bios: TiBo, Internet Archive, Olivetti M4-65 R2.03 A4BF, 18 September 2023: dump and photographs of the EPROM and BA2077 board. Physical provenance not independently verified; unknown rights.
The disk is created blank with a representative geometry. Use Olivetti Setup in Standard mode and install DOS from floppy. For 540 MB, choose High capacity.
product.olivetti-m4-66.creation.offer: 305 BOX · RAM 4 MB · VGA 1 MB · IDE 170/240/540 MB
